title: LoOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Looped Teachers
abstract: arXiv:2610.18162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation improves a model using guidance from the model itself, but it still requires a teacher that provides more useful predictions than the student. Existing approaches obtain such guidance by giving the teacher additional context or instructions. We ask whether it can instead come from changing how the same model uses its own layers. To address this, we introduce LoOPSD, which searches over a model's layer execution order to construct a stronger teacher and distills its advantage into the student. Specifically, we keep the model weights unchanged while searching for layers to repeat, and use the resulting teacher's predictions on student-generated prefixes to guide learning. We then alternate search and distillation, rebuilding the teacher from the updated student in each round so that the student progressively absorbs the gains from alternative layer execution. translated_title: LoOPSD：基于循环教师的策略内自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 策略内自蒸馏利用模型自身的指导来改进模型，但它仍然需要一个能够提供比学生更有用预测的教师。现有方法通过给教师提供额外的上下文或指令来获得这种指导。我们提出一个问题：这种指导是否可以改为来自改变同一模型使用其自身层的方式。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了LoOPSD，它通过搜索模型的层执行顺序来构建一个更强的教师，并将其优势蒸馏给学生。具体而言，我们在保持模型权重不变的情况下搜索需要重复的层，并使用由此得到的教师对学生生成的前缀的预测来指导学习。随后我们交替进行搜索和蒸馏，在每一轮中从更新后的学生重建教师，使学生逐步吸收来自替代层执行方式带来的收益。在数学和逻辑推理任务上的实验……
tldr: LoOPSD通过搜索模型的层执行顺序（如重复某些层）构建更强的循环教师，并将其优势蒸馏回学生模型，从而在不改变模型权重的情况下提升数学与逻辑推理能力。
en_tdlr: LoOPSD constructs a stronger looped teacher by searching over a model's layer execution order and distills its advantage back into the student, improving mathematical and logical reasoning without modifying the model weights.
